name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build a variational quantum classifier in Pen
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build a variational quantum classifier in PennyLane for 1D data: encode x via RX, use 2 trainable layers, train with square loss on the parity-like dataset y=sign(sin(1*x)), and report training accuracy. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
